Who We Are Accesso Franco helps organizations transform energy and operational data into trusted intelligence that supports better operational, financial, and investment decisions. Combining trusted standards, practical platforms, and engineering expertise, we turn the thousands of data points your assets generate every day into clarity you can act on. The Challenge We Solve Modern energy assets generate thousands of data points every day, yet the real value lies not in the data itself but in the decisions it enables. Too often, multiple data sources, inconsistent KPI definitions, manual reporting, and limited visibility leave decision-makers unsure which data to rely on. We solve that. What We Do Standards The SC-SEMS framework ensures data integrity, consistency, and interoperability. Project Commissioning Built for real-world operations and measurable business outcomes. Platform SimpleCore scales with your operations, from field devices to enterprise systems. Calibration & Lifecycle Services We stay with you beyond deployment to ensure sustainable, long-term value.
